message.content: **Summary:** I checked the broker's morning summary for AAPL, which showed the stock trading near $222.70 on a quiet session (volume ~41.2M shares) with no pending corporate actions, and confirmed the live quote at $222.70 (bid $222.68 / ask $222.72, as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). With $50,000 cash available and only an existing 100-share MSFT position, I decided to buy: the price action was unremarkable but the fundamentals from Apple's FY2024 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) — revenue of $391,035M, net income of $93,736M, and diluted EPS of $6.08 — support a modest starter position, and the mandate permits AAPL purchases. I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares at $222.80 (just above the ask, so it filled at $222.80), a total of about $9,803 — within the $10,000 per-order cap and well under the $20,000 daily total, with no money moved out of the account.
